name: Green Development Electricity Group of Tianjin Co., Ltd.
summary: Green Development Electricity Group of Tianjin Co., Ltd. engages in the investment, development, and operation of wind and solar energy in China. It is involved in development and construction of onshore and offshore wind power, photovoltaic power generation, and concentrated solar power. The company was formerly known as China Green Electricity Investment of Tianjin Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Green Development Electricity Group of Tianjin Co., Ltd. in December 2025. Green Development Electricity Group of Tianjin Co., Ltd. was founded in 1986 and is based in Beijing, China. Green Development Electricity Group of Tianjin Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Luneng Group Co.,Ltd.
